name: Banking Intent Routing
description: 1,200 synthetic messages a retail-bank customer sends to a chatbot, each labeled with one of 10 intents: balance, transfers, lost/stolen cards, disputes, loans, personal-info updates, new accounts, exchange rates, ATM problems and card activation.
task: Which banking intent does this customer message express?

labels.name: check_balance
labels.description: The customer asks how much money is in, available on or currently due on a checking, savings or credit-card account (current, available or pending balance). Loan and mortgage balances are loan_inquiry; a balance that is wrong because of an ATM deposit or withdrawal is atm_issue; contesting a charge is dispute_transaction.

labels.name: transfer_money
labels.description: The customer wants to send money to another person or move it between their own accounts: P2P payments, wires, international transfers, adding a payee, and setting up, changing or cancelling scheduled or recurring transfers. Only asking what conversion rate or fee would apply is exchange_rate; paying toward a loan or mortgage is loan_inquiry.

labels.name: card_lost_stolen
labels.description: The customer reports a card as lost, misplaced or stolen, or asks to block, freeze, lock or cancel a card because it is missing or stolen (including requesting a replacement for it). A card kept by an ATM is atm_issue; contesting specific charges once the loss is already reported is dispute_transaction; activating the replacement is card_activation.

labels.name: dispute_transaction
labels.description: The customer contests a specific charge or debit: unrecognised, fraudulent, duplicated, wrong amount, a cancelled subscription still billed, or a refund that never arrived — including chargebacks and contesting a fee already posted. Cash an ATM failed to dispense is atm_issue; reporting the card itself lost or stolen is card_lost_stolen.

labels.name: loan_inquiry
labels.description: The customer asks about borrowing: personal, auto, student or business loans, mortgages and home-equity credit — rates, eligibility, applications, pre-approval, payments, remaining balance or payoff, early repayment, deferral or refinancing. 'Rate' questions about currency conversion are exchange_rate.

labels.name: update_personal_info
labels.description: The customer wants to change or correct personal details on file: postal or mailing address, phone number, email address, or legal or preferred name. This label applies even when the reason involves another topic (e.g. missed transfer codes or a card mailed to an old address), as long as the request is the update itself.

labels.name: open_account
labels.description: The customer wants to open a new deposit account — checking, savings, joint, student, child or business — or asks about the requirements, documents, minimum deposit, features or fees of opening one. Taking out a loan is loan_inquiry, not opening an account.

labels.name: exchange_rate
labels.description: The customer asks about currency conversion: exchange rates, how much an amount is worth in another currency, or the fees and markups for paying, withdrawing or converting in a foreign currency (including foreign ATM withdrawal fees). Actually sending money abroad is transfer_money; contesting a fee already charged is dispute_transaction.

labels.name: atm_issue
labels.description: The customer has a problem with an ATM or ATM transaction — card retained or stuck, cash not dispensed or short (even if the account was debited), ATM errors or out-of-service machines, ATM deposits not credited — or wants to find an ATM. Fees for withdrawing cash abroad are exchange_rate; a card lost elsewhere is card_lost_stolen.

labels.name: card_activation
labels.description: The customer wants to activate a newly received, renewed or replacement card, set the PIN for that new card, or asks whether a new card is not working because it still needs activating. Reporting a card lost or stolen is card_lost_stolen.
